_comment: TOOL is public implementation and documentation.
DATA belongs in a PRIVATE Git companion, under version control; it is physically absent from this public tool.
_readme_diagrams: TOOL: docs/diagrams/*.dot, *.png and render.py document the public workflow without runtime mail or account data.
_audited: Public DATA sinks audited: heartbeat state/log, summary state, quality-review JSON, filter XML and pool CLI writes check their destinations once before effects. No source-tree fallback. Model-driven standalone review validates local-only policy before credential or mail access. Public CLI writes require an explicit checked database.
_data_note: Heartbeat cursors, action ledgers, pending topic headers, summary ledgers, log and pool database resolve from the selected PRIVATE companion.
Relative storage paths resolve from the companion, never cwd. Explicit CLI outputs and log destinations get the same path check: outside the public source tree.

em_runtime.private_path rejects destinations outside a Git worktree, in the source tree or behind filesystem aliases before credential or mail access. Normal and linked Git worktrees are supported. Repository visibility is not checked at runtime.
_data_sealed_note: These paths can contain runtime DATA and must not exist in the public source repository.
The seal blocks forced adds as well as ordinary tracked files; gitignore alone is insufficient.
Sealed paths are not public examples and do not require schemas stored beside them.
_data_home: Selected PRIVATE companion; storage defaults are data/state, data/email-monitor.log and data/pool.db beneath it.
